insurer: ICICI Lombard General Insurance Company Limited
sumInsured: As per Policy Schedule (Annual Sum Insured)

great.name: Restore Benefit
great.quote:
Reset Benefit Unlimited (Not applicable for unlimited SI)

We will reset up to 100% of the Annual Sum Insured, unlimited times in a Policy Year
great.reference: Policy Schedule (Benefits table): Sr. no. 7; Section IV(A)(7) Reset Benefit
great.explanation: The insurer refills up to 100% of the Sum Insured unlimited times within the same policy year. This greatly increases your claim capacity if your base Sum Insured is exhausted.

great.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
great.explanation: Medical expenses incurred up to 60 days before hospitalization are covered. This longer period helps cover related pre-admission costs better than many plans.

great.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
great.explanation: Medical expenses up to 180 days after discharge are covered. This extended period supports recovery costs well beyond standard coverage.

good.name: Room Rent
good.reference: Policy Schedule (Benefits table): Sr. no. 1 In Patient Care
good.explanation: Room rent is covered for all room types except suites. This provides broad room eligibility, though choosing a suite may lead to cost sharing.

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing Disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy with insurer.
good.reference: Section V(A) Pre-existing diseases Code - Excl01
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are covered after 36 months of continuous coverage. This waiting period is within the normal 2–4 year market range.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy with us.
good.reference: Section V(B) Specified disease/procedure waiting period Code- Excl02
good.explanation: Coverage for specified illnesses and procedures begins after 24 months. This is a standard waiting period for such conditions.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident
good.reference: Section V(C) 30-day waiting period Code - Excl03
good.explanation: Illnesses are not covered during the first 30 days except for accidents. This is a common initial waiting period in health insurance.

good.name: Built-in SI Buffer
good.quote:
Loyalty bonus 20% of SI up to 100% of SI (Not applicable for unlimited SI)

We will provide 20% Loyalty Bonus ... at the end of each Policy Year if policy is continuously renewed
good.reference: Policy Schedule (Benefits table): Sr. no. 12; Section IV(A)(12) Loyalty Bonus
good.explanation: You earn up to 100% extra Sum Insured as a loyalty bonus over renewals. This increases your coverage after the base Sum Insured is used.

good.name: Air Ambulance
good.quote:
Additional Base covers in Premium plan
1 Air Ambulance Cover Up to SI
good.reference: Policy Schedule (Benefits table): Additional Base covers in Premium plan
good.explanation: Air ambulance transport is covered up to the Sum Insured in the Premium plan. This helps in emergencies requiring urgent transfer.

good.name: Domiciliary Hospitalization
good.explanation: Home-based hospitalization is covered up to the Sum Insured when policy conditions are met. This supports treatment outside traditional hospitals.

good.name: Bariatric Surgery
good.quote:
Bariatric Surgery Up to SI

Bariatic surgery will have 36 months of waiting period
good.reference: Policy Schedule (Benefits table): Sr. no. 14; Section IV(A)(14) Bariatric Surgery
good.explanation: Bariatric surgery is covered after a 36-month waiting period. This allows coverage for weight-loss surgery under specified conditions.

good.name: PED Waiting Reduction
good.quote: On payment of additional premium, waiting period for Medical Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing Disease (PED) ... shall be reduced to 24 months
good.reference: Section IV(C)(1) Pre-exiting disease (PED) waiting period reduction
good.explanation: You can pay extra to reduce the PED waiting period to 24 months for accepted pre-existing conditions. This optional benefit helps if you have existing illnesses.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote:
We will cover ... medicines, drugs and consumables (other than those specified in the list of excluded expenses (non -medical) in Annexure I;

List of Non Payable Items ... 56 GLOVES ... 60 MASK ...
bad.reference: Section IV(A)(1) Inpatient Care; Section VI(B)(12) Non Payables List I
bad.explanation: Common hospital consumables like gloves and masks are excluded unless you opt for the Premium plan's 'Claim Protector'. This can lead to out-of-pocket expenses.

bad.name: Restore Restriction
bad.quote: The Reset Benefit will not be available for an Illness / Injury or related complications including but not limited to any relapse within 45 days in respect of which a claim has been paid in that Policy Year for the same Insured Person.
bad.explanation: Reset Benefit cannot be used for the same illness or relapse within 45 days in the same policy year. This limits coverage for repeat admissions of the same condition.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: Additional zone based Co-Payment ... would be levied on each and every claim in case medically necessary treatment has been taken in a zone higher ... than the zone for which premium has been paid
bad.reference: Section VI(B)(1) Zone based premium (Zone based co-payment table)
bad.explanation: If you get treatment in a higher-cost zone than your premium zone, an extra co-pay applies on every claim. This can significantly increase your out-of-pocket costs.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: Co-Payment means a cost sharing requirement under a health insurance policy that provides that the policyholder/insured will bear a specified percentage of the admissible claims amount.
bad.reference: Definitions: Co-Payment; Section VI(B)(1) mentions zone-based co-payment only
bad.explanation: The policy defines co-payment and mentions zone-based co-pay but does not clearly state if any standard co-pay applies otherwise. Confirm with insurer if base co-pay is zero or not.

unclear.name: No Claim Bonus
unclear.quote:
We will provide 20% Loyalty Bonus ... at the end of each Policy Year if policy is continuously renewed...

In the event of Claim, under the Policy during any subsequent Policy Year, the accrued Loyalty Bonus will not be reduced.
unclear.explanation: The policy offers a Loyalty Bonus that is not reduced after claims in subsequent years, but accrual depends on no claims in the expiring period. Clarify how this works for individual vs floater policies.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
